full_judgment: 6. It was stated by both the petitioners that they joined the Civil Service that was constituted, vide, Resolution No. F/25/4/50 Ests. dated November 8, 1950 which was published in the official Gazette as a Centralised Service on all-Pakistan basis called the Civil Service of Pakistan and the petitioners rights and privileges for career advancement were protected in terms of the CSP (composition and cadre) Rules, 1954 framed under the authority of the Constitution. It was further stated that the seniority of the petitioners in relation to the holders of listed posts, i.e. Officers not belonging to CSP but appointed substantively to a superior post on the CSP cadre by promotion from the provincial Civil Service, etc. is governed in terms of inter se seniority rules as embodied in the Establishment Division Notification No. 1/50/65-CI, dated November, 16, 1965 read with the ICS (Regulation of Seniority.) Rules, 19 mended in 1937.
